name: Chu Yuk-Gong
source:
He used to be a police officer in the Hong Kong Police Department.
He and his colleague, Lee Ying, were conducting a cleanup operation using the Web.
When he learned that his subordinate Lau Ming Wa was aware of the operation and began to investigate, he introduced his daughter Sammi to Lau in order to win her over.
In response, Lau began dating Sammi to obtain information about Chu.
At the stage when Lau had confided in her, Chu forced Lau to make a choice: take Sammi as his wife and rise in the ranks, or be killed.
Lau chose the former and joined Chu's army.
Chu later became a politician.
He was the mastermind behind the Temple Street terrorist attack.
